name: Neuenkirchen-Vörden (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Neuenkirchen-Vörden (a wheel, an arrow and a knot on white and blue).
history: The arms were approved by the Landkreis Vechta in 1992.

features.role: Neuenkirchen-Vörden arms — wheel, arrow and knot
